# SheetJS Community Edition

xlsx.full.min.js is the unmodified SheetJS CE 0.20.3 standalone reader, from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js.

Copyright (C) 2013-present SheetJS. Apache License 2.0; see SheetJS-LICENSE.txt. Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/.

Loaded locally when an administrator opens the Excel importer. Workbook bytes are parsed in the browser; reviewed question records are sent to the application API.
